obligation_summary: New framework: technology-based monitoring & supervision of stock-broker system audits
new_text: Framework for Monitoring and Supervision of System Audit of Stock Brokers (SBs) through Technology based Measures
notes: Entirely new section (0 occurrences in Aug-2024). Introduces a supervisory tech layer over system audits; its insertion is what shifts all subsequent Aug sections by +1 in Jun.

obligation_summary: New obligation: exchanges to build a web platform monitoring the whole system-audit lifecycle
new_text: Stock Exchanges shall develop web portal/ web based platform and create technology based mechanisms to monitor and supervise the entire system audit lifecycle of a stock broker
notes: New obligation on stock exchanges within the new §17.

obligation_summary: New obligation: capture auditor geo-location to confirm physical premises visit
new_text: exchanges shall capture the geo location of the auditor to ensure that physical visit is carried out by auditor in the premises of the stock broker
notes: New anti-fraud control on the audit process; no analogue in Aug-2024.

obligation_summary: New section: GIFT-IFSC Separate Business Unit facilitation for stock brokers
new_text: Facilitation to SEBI registered Stock Brokers to undertake securities market related activities in Gujarat International Finance Tech-city
notes: New section (0 occurrences in Aug-2024) enabling a Separate Business Unit (SBU) in GIFT-IFSC.

obligation_summary: New section: access to NDS-OM for trading in Government Securities via an SBU
new_text: Facilitation to SEBI registered Stock Brokers to access Negotiated Dealing System-Order Matching (NDS-OM) for trading in Government Securities

obligation_summary: New section: association of Board-regulated persons and their agents with certain persons
new_text: Association of persons regulated by the Board and their agents with certain persons
notes: New misc-part section (0 occurrences in Aug-2024).
